senses.gloss: m. (פָּגַם; cmp. פְּגִימָה) semicircular turret, niche in a city wall; also independent turret open on one side.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 5:1">Erub. V, 1</cite> how do you define city limits (v. <cite ref="P00059"><he>עָבַר</he></cite>)? <he>בית … פ׳ נכנס פ׳ יוצא</he> if (in a row of joined dwellings) one house stands outside the line and one inside, one turret (of the wall) is projected and one recedes.

<cite ref="Eruvin 55a:5">Ib. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>היה בית אחד יוצא כמין פ׳</he> if one house projects in the way of a turret (in a semicircle). Y. ib. V, 22ᵇ bot. [read:] <he>מן גו פ׳</he> measuring from the inside of the turret.

<cite ref="Eruvin 55a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>נותנין פ׳ לפ׳</he> we may allow an outer turret to a turret, i.e. we count the city limits from a turret which serves as a defence to a turret; a. e.—Pl. <he>פְּגוּמִים</he>. Erub. l. c.—Ch. <cite ref="Q00584"><he>פִּיגְמָא</he></cite>.—V. <cite ref="Q00061"><he>פְּגִימִין</he></cite>.
